build_multi_period_discriminator: build a MultiPeriodDiscriminator that applies period-based 2D convolution to real and generated audio for GAN training
build_multi_resolution_discriminator: build a MultiResolutionDiscriminator that evaluates real and generated audio at multiple STFT resolutions
build_multi_band_discriminator: build a MultiBandDiscriminator that splits audio into frequency bands and processes each with a separate convolutional network
build_multi_scale_cqt_discriminator: build a MultiScaleSubbandCQTDiscriminator that uses constant-Q transforms across multiple scales for audio discrimination
build_combined_discriminator: build a CombinedDiscriminator that chains multiple discriminator architectures into a single forward pass
